description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Direction No. 61, to direct all the Manufacturers & Traders that the information that shall be printed bottles, packs or containers of paints, varnishes & solvent w.e.f. 01.01.2017
reasoning: This gazette contains a Direction (No. 61) issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes regulatory requirements for manufacturers and traders regarding labeling of paints, varnishes and solvents, including specifications about lead content limits. This falls under "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and constitutes a "statutory instrument," making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
